name: Project Kuiper
description: Amazon's LEO broadband answer to Starlink — planned 3,236 satellites at 590-630 km in 98 orbital planes. First operational launches in 2023; FCC license requires 50% deployment by 2026, 100% by 2029.
scale_fact: If fully deployed, Kuiper will roughly double the active LEO population — the cumulative debris-avoidance burden goes with it.
